canonical_id: Double Ratchet locked outer-audit evaluator evolution

source.paper: Who Grades the Grader? Co-Evolving Evaluation Metrics and Skills for Self-Improving LLM Agents

artifact_evidence.metric_loop: evalratchet/ exposes drawback-detector pools, expression composition, anchored selection, synthesis/birth-gate/shadow-tier/retirement lifecycle and co-evolution driver.
artifact_evidence.skill_loop: A fixed copy of the separately released Ratchet skill loop is vendored under vendor/skillevo so the repository runs against one explicit code snapshot rather than an unpinned external moving target.
artifact_evidence.experiment_entrypoints: README gives concrete paper commands for metric evolution, anchor-guard and lifecycle ablations, reference skill evolution, co-evolution, and report-generation final-judge 2x2 analysis.
artifact_evidence.split_control: Screening plus deterministic seed-42 split builders freeze train/dev(eval_dev)/locked-test(eval_locked); experiment --seed changes loop stochasticity rather than task selection when stored split files exist.
artifact_evidence.paper_configuration: README states defaults pin loop roles to Claude Opus 4.7, with report final judge Opus 4.8, and provides the exact curriculum string and 3-seed convention (42,7,13).
artifact_evidence.result_contract: Every run is documented to write round-by-round loop.json, final result.json and SQLite stores, from which paper numbers are computed.
artifact_evidence.reproducibility_boundary: Repository explicitly excludes datasets, model outputs, run logs, result files and credentials. Report-generation additionally requires non-released task/evaluator data.

paper_claims.anchor_guard_failure: The paper reports that removing anchor guards can collapse the evolved metric to a vacuous always-pass detector while downstream skill training can still look competitive; this motivates direct evaluator auditing rather than downstream-score proxy validation.
paper_claims.locked_metric_improvement: The clean worker records a +0.21 locked-set agreement improvement over the bare LLM judge in code generation with paired p=0.014; retain this as primary-paper evidence pending independent rerun.
paper_claims.goodhart_repair: The paper reports a report-generation Goodhart episode detected by an independent judge and repaired by adding a detector; retain exact paper scope.
paper_claims.three_seed_scope: Primary experiments use three seeds, and the repository warns hosted LLM sampling is not deterministic even when split/synthesis ordering is seeded.

reproducibility_assessment.official_artifact_support: strong for method implementation, deterministic task splitting, paper command reconstruction, vendored skill-loop version and ablation entrypoints
reproducibility_assessment.independent_replication: not identified in targeted public search on 2026-08-25
reproducibility_assessment.judgment: Double Ratchet releases enough method code and experiment wiring to reconstruct the central evaluator/skill co-evolution protocol and its ablation arms. The paper's exact numerical outcomes are not independently auditable from the repository alone because datasets, original result files, model outputs and logs are deliberately excluded, and one of the three tasks needs unreleased report-generation data/evaluator support. Consequently the architecture and experimental recipe are strongly reproducible, while the headline effect sizes and Goodhart episode remain primary-study evidence until a third party reruns them.
exact_blockers: No original paper result directories, loop logs, model outputs or run stores are included; paper tables cannot be recomputed solely from the public commit.
Report-generation reproduction is incomplete from public materials because its task data and RAQS evaluator are explicitly not included.
Spider 2.0-Snow requires credentialed access to a hosted Snowflake warehouse, introducing external state, cost and run-to-run variation.
Core model access is via Amazon Bedrock hosted Claude models; --seed does not make model sampling deterministic, and future provider/model revisions can alter reruns.
The README specifies packages manually (pydantic, pyyaml, boto3 and optional snowflake connector) rather than documenting a fully hashed environment lock in the audited root.
No independent public rerun was found for the locked-audit agreement gain, anchor-guard collapse ablation, downstream-retention figures or reported Goodhart repair.
OpenCnid and similar third-party repositories are paper study/notes and influence records, not independent experimental replications.
reproducibility_assessment.scope: Strong released reference implementation for the proposed failure-expecting evaluator architecture. Do not label the anchor-guard result, +0.21 agreement lift or Goodhart repair independently replicated. Failure of the naive/no-anchor ablation is evidence for the exact tested evaluator-evolution configuration, not proof that every unanchored evolving evaluator collapses.

downstream_note: Useful as an executable positive-control family for evaluator-validity mechanisms, but any O-side adoption/evaluation should keep the locked audit inaccessible to both proposer and evolving evaluator and should separately test metric validity rather than infer it from downstream skill score.
